div.aria-label: Local Docker Compose mode, ppe environment shown (each environment type has its own stack, loopback address and domain): browser, CLI, a native Windows agent and LAN machines reach the host-native GrihaSetu edge Caddy at ppe.kardia.sonapraneeth.in over TLS; it forwards to the gateway Caddy container on 127.2.6.7, which routes to wf-api and the engine leader; engines use PostgreSQL and a blob volume; a Linux agent container runs task hosts that load the sample service containers.

header.p: Optional `wf local up --env <env>`: production builds of every Linux component run in Docker behind a gateway Caddy on 127.2.6.<E>, one stack per environment type. The GrihaSetu edge Caddy serves https://<env>.kardia.sonapraneeth.in (dev or ppe) on the LAN with its mkcert umbrella certificate. Shown: the default ppe stack (127.2.6.7). The Windows agent stays native; pure local `aspire run` on localhost remains the inner loop.
